purpose: Offline official product-cover thumbnails for four planned library entries only; these images do not select playable editions, player counts, rules or development schedules.

postprocessing: Pillow mechanical conversion only. Keep complete packaging and aspect ratio; SCOUT v2 frames the alpha>127 physical-box bbox with 6 source pixels padding, removing only outer low-alpha canvas/shadow. No painting, stretching, package-text changes or replacement backgrounds.
